notes_for_editor: Thin record. The 1935 NGS description (via a volunteer site) places the station about seven miles north of Jasper; the TSHA entry places 'the Horton lookout tower' three miles to the south, reference point not stated, in the mid-1980s. The sources do not show these are the same tower or what the three miles is measured from, so the story does not link them. The record's status_note matches the FFLA asterisk footnote; no correction proposed. No build date, height, staffing, fire history, cab-removal date or access found. A YouTube video titled 'Horton Fire Lookout Tower Jasper County TX' appeared in search results but was not read. Confidence low.
